steps.description:
In many applications, we need to control the layout of our display. Row and column are used to control the starting position of the text on the LCD.


There are also different ways to achieve the same result. Test out the two blocks below to see if they have the same output.




Display the following on the LCD for 1 second.

In many applications, we need to control the layout of our display. Row and column are used to control the starting position of the text on the LCD.



Setting the LCD's Display Type to "On" is useful for displaying multiple LCD blocks together. Try out the following example.


Using LCD blocks, display the following together for 3 seconds

  1. Display "Team A" at the top left of the LCD.
  2. Display "Score 1" at the bottom left of the LCD.
  3. They should appear together, and disappear together after 3 seconds.

In many applications, we need to control the layout of our display. Row and column are used to control the starting position of the text on the LCD.



Setting the LCD's Display Type to "On" is useful for displaying multiple LCD blocks together. Try out the following example.


            

Using LCD blocks, display the following Soccer Scores together for 3 seconds:

  1. Display "Team A" at the top left of the LCD.
  2. Display "Team B" at the top right of the LCD.
  3. Display "Score 1" at the bottom left of the LCD.
  4. Display "Score 5" at the bottom right of the LCD.

A flowchart can be used to illustrate the flow of your code and is usually used in designing a program. In this step, you will practise drawing flowchart of your previous step.

As this is your first flowchart, ask your instructor to guide you.

Load the snippet of your previous step's codes on a separate browser tab.

Refer to the notes on flowchart: https://tinyurl.com/TheLabHatFlowchart


Note: Flowcharts will be saved in snippets under "Diagrams and Flowcharts". If you want to continue editing a previously saved flowchart, load it from the snippets.
